00050 #define DEFAULT_UGEN_DOCS   <I>Not yet documented although the argument name should be reasonably clear</I>.
00051 #define COMMON_UGEN_DOCS    <B>Generic %UGen argument documentation:</B>                                        \
00052                             Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these              \
00053                             may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions).                 \
00054                             Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly        \
00055                             not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will                  \
00056                             generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being             \
00057                             created is made multichannel via other arguments.                                   \
00058                             Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific              \
00059                             purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel          \
00060                             Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)    \
00061                             \n\
00062                             \n\

00693     inline float* processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw()
00694     {   
00695         if(channel < 0) {
00696             // process all channels
00697             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00698                 internalUGens[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00699             
00700             return 0;
00701         } else {
00702             // process one channel and return a pointer to its block
00703             int internalChannel = channel % numInternalUGens;
00704             float* block = internalUGens[internalChannel]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00705             return block;
00706         }
00707     }

00719     float* prepareAndProcessBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel = -1) throw();
00720     
00728     inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00729     {   
00730         bool shouldDelete = false;
00731         
00732         for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) {
00733             if(internalUGens[i]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID)) {
00734                 shouldDelete = true;
00735                 break;
00736             }
00737         }
00738         
00739         if(shouldDelete) {
00740             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00741                 internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
00742             
00743             numInternalUGens = 1;
00744             internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00745             internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);        
00746         } else {
00747             for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00748                 internalUGens[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00749         }
00750     }

01050     inline static void initialise() throw()
01051     {
01052         if(isInitialised == false)
01053         {
01054             null = UGen();
01055             nullKr = UGen().kr();
01056             Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 513, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01057             Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(8193, 0.0, 2.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize();
01058 //          Buffer::tableSine512  = Buffer::line( 1025, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(512);
01059 //          Buffer::tableSine8192 = Buffer::line(16385, 0.0, 4.0 * pi).sin().shrinkSize(8192);
01060 
01061             Buffer constantPanTemp;
01062             constantPanTemp = Buffer::line(512, -pi4, pi4) << Buffer::line(512, pi4, -pi4);
01063             Buffer::tableConstantPan512 = (constantPanTemp.cos() - constantPanTemp.sin()) * sqrt22;
01064             isInitialised = true;
01065         }
01066     }
